title: Normalization ω_n·μH[n] = 2ⁿ·μHE[n] on ℝ^N
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ and let s ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set. Then ω_n·μH[n](s) = 2ⁿ·μHE[n](s). Here ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) is the volume of the open unit ball of ℝⁿ (ω_0 = 1), μH[n] is Mathlib's unnormalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure, and μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure (Simon's Hⁿ). Both sides are outer-measure values in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn N)), volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1) * μH[(n : ℝ)] s = 2 ^ n * μHE[n] s
